notes: Roster list aligned to current public Street Fighter 6 roster listings.
Designed for local RAG / character overview queries.
Summaries are concise starter docs for chatbot retrieval, not lore-complete biographies.
Because some public sites block scraping, these docs are intentionally local and curated.

characters.name: Ryu
characters.overview: A disciplined martial artist who keeps traveling in search of stronger opponents and personal growth.
characters.playstyle_summary: Balanced fireball, anti-air, and footsies character built around solid fundamentals and honest spacing.
characters.keywords: shoto, zoning, anti-air, fireball, fundamentals

characters.name: Ken
characters.overview: An aggressive rival to Ryu whose toolkit pushes offense harder and converts hits into corner carry.
characters.playstyle_summary: Fast-paced pressure, run/Dragonlash offense, explosive Drive Rush conversions, and strong corner momentum.
characters.keywords: rushdown, shoto, corner carry, pressure, confirms

characters.name: Chun-Li
characters.overview: A former ICPO agent with elite normals, air mobility options, and Serenity Stream routes.
characters.playstyle_summary: Strong neutral buttons, walk speed, anti-airs, and technical routing with stance follow-ups.
characters.keywords: footsies, stance, anti-air, walk speed, confirms

characters.name: Luke
characters.overview: A modern MMA-inspired fighter designed as a highly stable, beginner-friendly all-rounder.
characters.playstyle_summary: Great mids, straightforward confirms, solid anti-airs, and very reliable pressure for standard game plans.
characters.keywords: all-rounder, stable, confirms, anti-air, mids

characters.name: Jamie
characters.overview: A breakdance-inspired fighter who powers up through drink levels during the match.
characters.playstyle_summary: Momentum-oriented offense that gets stronger with drinks, rekka pressure, and stylish corner routes.
characters.keywords: drink levels, momentum, rekka, offense, snowball

characters.name: Guile
characters.overview: A military veteran who controls space with Sonic Boom and disciplined anti-air defense.
characters.playstyle_summary: Classic keep-out character with powerful projectiles, flash-kick anti-air, and strong screen control.
characters.keywords: charge, zoning, sonic boom, flash kick, defense

characters.name: Kimberly
characters.overview: A fast ninja-style fighter who overwhelms opponents with movement, sprays, and mix-up pressure.
characters.playstyle_summary: Explosive offense, mobility, side-switch pressure, and setplay once she gets close.
characters.keywords: rushdown, mobility, mix-up, setplay, ninja

characters.name: Juri
characters.overview: A taekwondo-based fighter with strong movement, pressure resets, and resource-enhanced offense.
characters.playstyle_summary: Flexible neutral and offense with stored options, tricky timing, and strong corner harassment.
characters.keywords: mobility, pressure, stocks, corner, timing

characters.name: Dee Jay
characters.overview: A rhythm-heavy kickboxer with feints, movement tricks, and strong damage when he gets rolling.
characters.playstyle_summary: Versatile offense and midrange control with fakeouts, burst damage, and tempo shifts.
characters.keywords: feints, burst, midrange, rhythm, pressure

characters.name: Manon
characters.overview: A judoka and model who builds permanent medal levels through command-grab success.
characters.playstyle_summary: Uses long pokes and threat of command throws to force mistakes and snowball damage.
characters.keywords: grappler, medals, command throw, pokes, snowball

characters.name: Marisa
characters.overview: A towering gladiator whose heavy strikes and armored tools punish hesitation brutally.
characters.playstyle_summary: High damage bruiser with armored pressure, giant buttons, and scary punish routes.
characters.keywords: armor, damage, bruiser, big normals, punish

characters.name: JP
characters.overview: A mastermind who controls screen space with portals, spikes, and delayed threats.
characters.playstyle_summary: Trap-heavy zoning and oppressive setups that reward preparation and spacing.
characters.keywords: setplay, zoning, traps, portal, control

characters.name: Zangief
characters.overview: The classic wrestling grappler who wins by forcing close-range fear and throw guesses.
characters.playstyle_summary: Huge reward off command grabs, anti-air grabs, and intimidating close-range reads.
characters.keywords: grappler, command grab, reads, close range, fear

characters.name: Dhalsim
characters.overview: A yoga master with unmatched reach and unusual air movement.
characters.playstyle_summary: Extreme keep-out, teleport trickery, and awkward angles that frustrate conventional neutral.
characters.keywords: long range, teleport, zoning, unorthodox, float

characters.name: Cammy
characters.overview: A close-range pressure specialist with fast movement and strong strike/throw offense.
characters.playstyle_summary: Relentless rushdown, whiff punishes, divekick threats, and stable confirms when in range.
characters.keywords: rushdown, speed, strike/throw, divekick, whiff punish

characters.name: E. Honda
characters.overview: A sumo wrestler with direct pressure tools, headbutt threat, and corner carry.
characters.playstyle_summary: Simple, forceful offense that tests defense and capitalizes on respect.
characters.keywords: sumo, pressure, headbutt, direct offense, corner carry

characters.name: Blanka
characters.overview: A wild fighter with rolling movement, doll setups, and odd angles of attack.
characters.playstyle_summary: Chaotic offense, mobility tricks, and unusual pressure patterns that punish unfamiliarity.
characters.keywords: trickster, mobility, doll, setplay, unusual angles

characters.name: Lily
characters.overview: A compact fighter who uses wind-enhanced specials to threaten sudden entries.
characters.playstyle_summary: Simple but dangerous pressure once wind stocks are active, with command-grab style threat layered in.
characters.keywords: wind stocks, entries, pressure, burst, read-based

characters.name: Rashid
characters.overview: A hyper-mobile fighter who uses wind and movement to create layered offense.
characters.playstyle_summary: Fast screen control, corner chaos, and rotating pressure sequences built on mobility.
characters.keywords: mobility, wind, pressure, corner, speed

characters.name: A.K.I.
characters.overview: A technical poison-themed fighter who rewards setup awareness and toxic pressure.
characters.playstyle_summary: Applies poison, controls awkward ranges, and converts status advantage into tricky offense.
characters.keywords: poison, setup, technical, spacing, status

characters.name: Ed
characters.overview: A compact boxer with psycho-powered extensions and strong midrange pressure.
characters.playstyle_summary: Strong confirms, quick offense, and good pressure tools from practical ranges.
characters.keywords: boxing, midrange, pressure, confirms, psycho power

characters.name: Akuma
characters.overview: A demonically powerful shoto with explosive offense and lower durability.
characters.playstyle_summary: Top-end offense, air fireball pressure, high damage, and great conversion power at the cost of fragility.
characters.keywords: glass cannon, shoto, air fireball, offense, damage

characters.name: M. Bison
characters.overview: A returning dictator built around oppressive offense, plus frames, and momentum.
characters.playstyle_summary: Bullying pressure, scary corner carry, and explosive damage when he establishes offense.
characters.keywords: pressure, plus frames, offense, corner carry, momentum

characters.name: Terry
characters.overview: A traveling fighter known as the Hungry Wolf, blending straightforward control with explosive confirms.
characters.playstyle_summary: Strong grounded buttons, practical confirms, anti-air tools, and accessible offense that still hits hard.
characters.keywords: brawler, confirms, grounded, anti-air, hungry wolf

characters.name: Mai
characters.overview: The heir to Shiranui-style ninja arts, using fans, flame, and mobility to pressure from unusual angles.
characters.playstyle_summary: Mobile offense, evasive movement, fan-based space control, and slippery pressure sequences.
characters.keywords: mobility, fans, ninja, evasive, pressure

characters.name: Elena
characters.overview: A capoeira fighter with long-reaching kicks and fluid movement.
characters.playstyle_summary: Pokes from unusual ranges, fluid movement, and rhythm-based offense/defense transitions.
characters.keywords: capoeira, long limbs, movement, rhythm, pokes

characters.name: Sagat
characters.overview: A towering Muay Thai emperor built around towering normals and fireball control.
characters.playstyle_summary: Classic high/low fireball zoning, long-range control, and punishing anti-airs with big damage.
characters.keywords: zoning, fireball, anti-air, long range, muay thai

characters.name: Alex
characters.overview: A wrestler who blends direct strikes, movement, and command-grab threat.
characters.playstyle_summary: Midrange bruiser with explosive reads, command-throw threat, and momentum once he gets going.
characters.keywords: grappler, brawler, command throw, bruiser, momentum

characters.name: C. Viper
characters.overview: A high-execution agent with fast movement and layered offense.
characters.playstyle_summary: Technical offense, feints, burst entries, and advanced combo routing for specialists.
characters.keywords: technical, feints, rushdown, high execution, burst
